title: Falling Up
label: Echoes of the Infinite
shareDescription: BURKO's new single 'Falling Up' is out now on Echoes of the Infinite. Sound without boundaries.
body: 'Falling Up' is BURKO's latest transmission on Echoes of the Infinite, a paradox rendered in sound where descent becomes ascent and gravity loses its grip. Leaning into the darker, dream-born tones he's carried across years of releases on ARMADA, Ultra, mau5trap, and Odd One Out, it pushes his new label deeper into its own sonic unknown.

Built on a hypnotic, psy-leaning groove and a bassline that pulls you upward as it drops, 'Falling Up' is made for the 3am hour, that weightless stretch of night where the floor disappears and the only way out is through. Out now in extended and radio edits, and already finding its home on the 'Nightrider' rabbit hole.
